notes: All 65 insertion-effect types (0–64) are transcribed mechanically from the SC-88 Pro Effect List.
Roland starred value tables *1–*14 are shared codecs, so timing/frequency mappings are defined once.
default_raw is always an actual SysEx byte.
default_from_manual=false means the text extraction did not expose an unambiguous default; the generator uses the first legal raw value pending hardware/visual verification.
